methodology: Wall-clock, agent-assisted: the spike's maintenance loop is a coding agent driving the same dump-unmatched → edit pattern → replay → test workflow a human maintainer would follow, timed from first artifact inspection to a green suite. Timestamps were recorded immediately around each session on the day logged. The numbers price this project's actual maintenance workflow; a keyboard-only estimate would need to be derived, not measured.

add_pattern_trials.notes: The needle covers all three versions identically — no drift on this surface. The shortfalls that remain are the fold's by-construction per-event under-fire: the TUI collapses two batched Read events into one 'Read 2 files' line, so the covering pattern fires once for two expectations on every settled screen and on the 120×40 stream, where repaint churn does not duplicate the fold the way the 80×24 stream's does.
